Indirect Objects
• A complement that appears in sentences with a direct object.
• Tells to whom / for whom / to what / for what the action of a verb is done.
What is an Indirect Object?
• After the main verb (if no preposition)
• OR after the direct object and a preposition 
How to Find It?
• Mother gave me the rest of the chores
• Mother gave the rest of the chores to me
• Direct Object → the rest of the chores
• Indirect Object → me
Example
Indirect vs Direct Objects
Direct Object
• Receives the action 
directly.
• Answers: What? or 
Whom?
• Example: She 
bought a book.
Indirect Object
• Shows to whom / for 
whom / to what / for 
what the action is 
done.
• Appears before the 
direct object (without 
a preposition) or 
after with “to/for”.
• Example: She 
bought me a book. 
// She bought a 
book for me.
Similarities
• Both are objects of a 
verb (they complete 
the meaning of the 
action).
• Both are usually 
nouns, pronouns, or 
noun phrases.
• Both answer a 
question about the 
action.

Game: Sentence Roulette
Rules
1. Start - First student writes a Subject + Verb.
2. Pass - Next student adds an Object or a Complement or an Adverbial. If 
unable to then students can start a new sentence. 
3. Expand - Keep adding until the sentence is complete.
4. Continue - Next student starts a new S+V sentence that links to the 
previous one.
5. Goal - Together, build a cohesive, logical paragraph about their 
hometown or families.
• Timer mode: Each student has only 20 seconds to add their part.
• Scoring (optional): 1 point for each correct addition. Bonus points if the 
paragraph is especially creative or funny.
Purpose
• Practice building complete sentences step by step.
• Reinforce knowledge of sentence components: Subject, 
Verb, Object, Complement, Adverbials.
• Work together to create a cohesive, logical paragraph.

HOMEWORK: COMPREHENSIVE GRAMMAR REVIEW
Mục tiêu: Ôn tập Cấu trúc câu cốt lõi (Core Sentence Structure), Cụm danh từ (Noun Phrases), Mệnh đề danh từ (Noun Clauses), Mệnh đề quan hệ & Rút gọn (Relative Clauses & Reduced Forms), và So sánh nâng cao (Advanced Comparisons).
EXERCISE 1: Core Sentence Structure & Subject - Verb Agreement
Xác định Chủ ngữ chính (Core Subject) và chia Động từ (Verb) trong ngoặc cho phù hợp.
The majority of vehicles in Vietnam (be) _________ motorcycles.
How factories treat their toxic waste (have) _________ a huge influence on the environment.
A number of criminals (have) _________ been released early due to good behavior.
One of the students' top priorities (be) _________ to achieve a high score in the IELTS exam.
Both the government and the citizens (need) _________ to be well aware of the environmental laws.
EXERCISE 2: Building Powerful Noun Phrases
Nâng cấp các danh từ đơn giản (in đậm) thành một Cụm danh từ (Noun Phrase) phức tạp hơn bằng cách sắp xếp các từ cho sẵn vào đúng vị trí (Mạo từ + Trạng từ + Tính từ + Danh từ bổ trợ + Danh từ chính + Mệnh đề quan hệ / Cụm giới từ).
The table is expensive. (wooden / beautiful / round / from Vietnam / which I bought yesterday / a / large) => ____________________________________________________________________ is expensive.
The student won an international prize last year. (hardworking / from my English class / extremely / who always helps others / the) => ____________________________________________________________________ won an international prize last year.
The supercomputer is located in Area 51. (quantum / extremely modern / which was created by A.I scientists / an) => ____________________________________________________________________ is located in Area 51.
EXERCISE 3: Complex Sentences & Noun Clauses
Kết hợp hai câu đơn thành một câu phức có chứa Mệnh đề danh từ (Noun-clause) đóng vai trò làm Chủ ngữ (Subject) hoặc Tân ngữ/Bổ ngữ (Object/Complement).
The climate is changing at an unprecedented rate. Scientists have discovered this. => Scientists have discovered that _________________________________________.
How does the new economic policy work? The public does not fully understand it. => The public does not fully understand how _________________________________________.
The Earth is getting warmer. This is an undeniable truth. => The truth is that _________________________________________.
He wants something from the negotiation. I don't know exactly. => I don't know what _________________________________________.
EXERCISE 4: Relative Clauses to Participle Phrases (Reduced Forms)
Rút gọn các mệnh đề quan hệ (Relative Clauses) trong các câu sau thành Cụm phân từ (Present/ Past/ Perfect Participle Phrases).
The policies which were introduced by the government last year have reduced traffic congestion. => The policies _________________________________________ have reduced traffic congestion.
The researchers who are conducting the survey on renewable energy are from Oxford University. => The researchers _________________________________________ are from Oxford University.
After he had finished his assignment, Tom went out to play with his friends. (Dùng Perfect Participle) => _________________________________________, Tom went out to play with his friends.
Any child who plays sports regularly tends to be more physically active. => Any child _________________________________________ tends to be more physically active.
EXERCISE 5: Advanced Comparisons (IELTS Writing Application)
Viết lại câu sử dụng các cấu trúc so sánh nâng cao (Parallel Comparison, Special Comparison) sao cho nghĩa không đổi.
When there are more cars on the road, the congestion becomes worse. (Dùng cấu trúc "The more... the more") => The more _________________________, the more _________________________.
If you start your exam preparation early, the test will be easy for you. (Dùng cấu trúc "The + comparative..., the + comparative") => The earlier _________________________, the easier _________________________.
The number of hours people work in Japan is 40 hours. The number of hours people work in Germany is also 40 hours. (Dùng cấu trúc "the same + N + as") => People in Japan work _________________________________________ people in Germany.
Life in the countryside is quiet, but life in the city is much more interesting. (Dùng cấu trúc "Compared with / In comparison with") => Compared with _________________________, _________________________.
EXERCISE 6: Error Identification & Correction
